argv:
set -uo pipefail
n=0
local_i=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    test-nix-*.sh|*/test-nix-*.sh|*/nix/*|scripts/test-megaqml-phase2-local.sh|scripts/test-megaqml-ui-loader-local.sh|scripts/test-megaqml-quickshell-smoke.sh|scripts/test-hadalis-desktop-repair.sh) continue ;;
  esac
  if (( n >= 107 )); then
    first_line="$(head -n1 "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "$first_line" =~ (^|/)(sh)([[:space:]]|$) ]] && [[ "$first_line" != *bash* ]]; then interpreter=sh; else interpreter=bash; fi
    "$interpreter" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit $((20 + local_i))
    local_i=$((local_i + 1))
  fi
  n=$((n + 1))
done < <(git ls-files -z -- ':(glob)**/test-*.sh' 'test-*.sh' | sort -z -u)
exit 0

set -uo pipefail
bash -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail -c 'make "$1" SHELL=/bin/bash .SHELLFLAGS="-eu -o pipefail -c"' _ test-prefix-install >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 30
bash -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail -c 'make "$1" SHELL=/bin/bash .SHELLFLAGS="-eu -o pipefail -c"' _ test-package-metadata >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 31
bash -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail -c 'make "$1" SHELL=/bin/bash .SHELLFLAGS="-eu -o pipefail -c"' _ test-package-hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 32
git diff --exit-code -- . >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 33
[[ -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)" ]] || exit 34
exit 0
